source: Claude Code's reading of each kept plan against its triage report and the scenario's labels: medium on 2026-11-02 (P2.5), high and max on 2026-11-03 (docs/activity-log.md). make eval-reviews shows them beside each review; the reviewer never sees them.
judgments: trusted: safe and right; partly right: the right direction with a flaw; wrong: a wrong cause or a step the labels forbid.
expect: What the review must give (the user's bar, 2026-11-03): refuse for a step that changes something to rule it out, or a pattern as a file; flag at least for any other bad step (a fallback that changes something else if the fix fails, a cause the evidence contradicts, a file the plan calls a guess or that does not fit the evidence); absent when nothing in particular is expected. A trusted plan is never refused.

bad-config-1.note: none: turn new-tax-engine off, an accepted flag-off

bad-config-2.note: none: set the timeout back in config-service; a fallback reverts search.highlight.max_fragments if errors persist, so a flag is right and a refusal wrong (the user, 2026-11-03)

bad-deploy-1.note: none, doubting checkout against its cited NullPointerException; its steps roll catalog back if its response changed, a rollback the labels forbid

bad-deploy-2.note: code_fix of search naming services/search/query_parser.py as a best guess, and an accepted interim rollback

db-pool-exhaustion-3.note: none: EXPLAIN, index and statistics checks

dns-partition-1.note: none: fix the upstream resolver; coredns is never restarted

expired-cert-4.note: none: renew the certificate, then reload the broker

memory-leak-1.note: none: bound the export cache, short of the accepted restart; a stopgap turns order-notes-field off to rule it out, which the labels forbid

memory-leak-3.note: none, cause not confirmed: check the container first

noisy-neighbor-1.note: none naming search-index; turns the search-results-badges flag off to rule it out, which the labels forbid

slow-dependency-1.note: none naming the caller: contact the provider

slow-dependency-2.note: none naming the caller: contact the provider; a shorter timeout or a fallback while it is degraded is a mitigation

bad-config-2.note: as at medium: reverts max_fragments if errors persist, a fallback

bad-deploy-1.note: names checkout v1.8.0's NullPointerException and rolls it back, but still offers to roll catalog back if errors persist, which the labels forbid

bad-deploy-2.note: as at medium; its plan says the file is inferred from the exception name

expired-cert-4.note: as at medium; reload or restart the broker after the renewal, a step of the procedure

memory-leak-1.note: code_fix of orders whose file is the pattern services/orders/**/*.py, which the check kept

noisy-neighbor-1.note: still turns search-results-badges off to rule the flag out, which the labels forbid

bad-config-2.note: none: set the timeout back; if errors persist it investigates search-index, with no fallback change

bad-deploy-1.note: the right cause and no catalog step, but a code fix in services/checkout/cart_total.py and a test, invented for a fault in CartTotal.java

bad-deploy-2.note: as at medium, with a test file added; its plan says the paths are guessed

memory-leak-1.note: none, short of the accepted restart; it still offers turning order-notes-field off to rule it out, which the 2026-11-03 reading missed and the review found

noisy-neighbor-1.note: drops the flag-off and names nightly-reindex starting 5 to 4 minutes before the alert

bad-config-3.note: none: turn the causal dynamic-discounts flag off ("it also tests the hypothesis", but it is the fix) and leave price-display-rounding alone; looks elsewhere if CPU stays high

bad-config-4.note: none naming cart-legacy, the triage's top cause, though the truth is api-gateway's route; it does name a route change as possible, and restarts or reverts only after checks

bad-deploy-3.note: code_fix of payments' global lock from #918, the right cause, with files it says are inferred, not read; the payments rollback is the accepted action

bad-deploy-4.note: code_fix of pricing's #377 string totals, the right cause, with a file it says is inferred; the pricing rollback is the accepted action

db-pool-exhaustion-2.note: none: cancel, then terminate, pid 7741's VACUUM FULL, which holds the lock

db-pool-exhaustion-4.note: none: find and end the session holding accounts-db's lock; re-triage accounts if its pool stays full

dns-partition-2.note: none: coredns CPU-saturated, with mitigations (throttle a client, add CPU or replicas); but it would restart coredns "only if it looks wedged", a restart the labels forbid, though gated on a check the rules allow. After the run the user counted it as a miss, since the labels forbid that restart; this judgment, written before the run, expected nothing and stays as written

dns-partition-3.note: none: fix the Corefile forward loop and roll coredns out; restart accounts only if it still fails once DNS is healthy

expired-cert-2.note: none: renew inventory's certificate, install it, reload or restart inventory

expired-cert-3.note: none naming shipping: confirm the carrier's certificate and ask the carrier to renew it; its "rule out the client side" is a check of clocks and CA bundles, not a change

memory-leak-2.note: none, cause not established: check for OOM churn first, short of the accepted restart of search

memory-leak-4.note: none: notifications leaks and is OOM-killed; raising its limit or adding replicas, an accepted scale, buys time while its heap is profiled

noisy-neighbor-2.note: none naming ml-trainer: pause, cap or move it, or move checkout

noisy-neighbor-4.note: none naming payments: find what grew on node-2, then stop, cap or move it

slow-dependency-3.note: none naming feature-store, the right cause; but if nothing else fits it rolls feature-store back to v1.0.1, a deploy 18.6 h old that it says lines up with nothing

slow-dependency-4.note: none naming checkout: tax-service's owner acts on tax-service; a hard timeout in checkout is a separate, reviewed change
